Election at a glance

Coverage includes U.S. Senate, U.S. House and governor. The governor flip count covers the 36 state races. Chamber totals use called seats and Senate holdovers, including independents who caucus with a party.

Flips compare civicAPI’s calls with its election-day seat-holder party. Close races are ranked by the top two candidates’ margin among reported votes after at least 1,000 votes are counted. Rankings can change as more ballots come in. Source and methodology ↗
